Every ranked result is a commercial service page from a small local studio (repid.uz, oqila.uz, innosoft.uz, web-sayt.uz, seo-first.uz, softmedia.uz, optimize.uz, vox.uz), with no authority domain among them. This is the cleanest commercial SERP measured in this market and the only meaningful one that is not gated behind a Google Business Profile, because the local pack in Uzbekistan attaches to agency-framed queries and not to service-framed ones. The plural «seo xizmatlari» returned no volume, so the singular is the correct target.
